messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty AUTO-PAGE fired -> inference-gateway-usw2: sustained 5xx sawtooth spike, 25% errors over 2m. PD incident P01-314. Link: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/P01-314 :rotating_light:
sara (oncall): acked the PD alert, i'm oncall for the window. starting triage. :eyes:
mike: copying — checking ingress LB and backend health now. any customer-facing complaints?
jordan: seeing retry storms in logs, lots of upstream 502 from kvcache eviction events earlier.
alex: quick check: are canary routes live? `curl -sI https://gw-usw2.internal/health | head -n1` returns 200 for canary but main route 502.
sara (oncall): @mike @jordan prioritize traffic routing and kv-cache warm. can we divert to fallback model pool?
mike: running haproxy stats snapshot:
```
BACKEND inference-be-1: requests=1200, 5xx=420 (35%), queue=12
BACKEND inference-be-2: requests=1100, 5xx=280 (25%), queue=8
```
mike: backend-level 5xx concentrated on be-1, latencies spiking.
jordan: looks correlated with kvcache evictions at 2024-04-20T03:15:xxZ — eviction churn likely causing prefix misses and heavy decode load.
opsbot: autoscale: requested +2 replicas for inference-dedicated-usw2 (scale set id: pool-77). ETA ~45s.
asara (oncall): typo — sara (oncall): scaling acknowledged, warming cache after replicas up.
alex: routing test: toggled weight: inference-be-1 -> 10%, inference-be-2 -> 60%, fallback-pool -> 30% (manual override). watching errors.
mike: after route change, 5xx rate dropped to ~14% in next 30s. still seeing intermittent 502s on in-flight prefix requests.
jordan: suggestion: temporarily reduce max_batch_size from 16 -> 8 for be-1 to reduce OOM/retry pressure. can do per-route param.
sara (oncall): do it. @mike can you apply?
mike: applied per-route override; `max_batch_size=8` for be-1. confirmed in config: `route inference-be-1 { max_batch_size: 8 }`.
opsbot: new replicas are healthy and joined pool (replica ids r-223, r-224). cache warm job started (warming prefixes: 1200).
alex: customer impact check: top 5 customers by p50 latency showed increases but no active error escalations from sales. sending short status note to #customer-impact.
oncall-rotator (oncall-rotator): FYI I replaced overnight oncall for next 30m to help with blameless triage rotation.
incident-bot: PD note: P01-314 escalated to SEV oncall at 1725008655. ack chain complete.
sara (oncall): current metrics: 5xx down to 6% system-wide, p95 latencies steady. continuing to monitor for next 15m.
mike: following logs show graceful retries instead of hard failures after route change:
```
[2024-04-20T03:18:12Z] req=abcd-1234 status=200 model=fallback-pool latency=120ms
[2024-04-20T03:18:13Z] req=abcd-1235 status=502 model=inference-be-1 action=retry
[2024-04-20T03:18:14Z] req=abcd-1235 status=200 model=inference-be-2 latency=95ms
```
jordan: saving for postmortem: root cause likely kvcache eviction cascade + aggressive batching on degraded nodes. propose follow-ups: - eviction threshold tuning - autoscale threshold adjustments - per-route batch safety limits - add synthetic warmers for heavy prefixes
sara (oncall): agreed. i'll create a preliminary incident note and assign follow-ups. leaving thread open for 15m of quiet to ensure stability. :thumbsup:
opsbot: cleanup: cleared manual overrides on routing after pool stabilized at 1725008700.
alex: confirming no active customer pages. will coordinate with comms if anything changes.
sara (oncall): closing PD incident in 10m if stable. great response, team. :tada:
